svg.aria-label: AI-first SaaS on AWS — build and operate with Kiro
svg.title: AI-first SaaS on AWS — build and operate with Kiro
svg.text: AI-first SaaS on AWS — build and operate with Kiro

Every persona works through Kiro (specs, steering, skills, hooks); changes reach AWS only through gated CI and CloudFormation; agents read AWS through the AWS MCP Server; CloudWatch Omni and AWS DevOps Agent close the loop

g.data-tip: Each persona works through its Kiro agent and skills; requests become EARS specs.

g.title: 1. Each persona works through its Kiro agent and skills; requests become EARS specs.

g.data-tip: Kiro implements spec tasks and opens pull requests (Implements: spec#task).

g.title: 2. Kiro implements spec tasks and opens pull requests (Implements: spec#task).

g.data-tip: CI runs the spec gate, tenant-isolation tests, AI tenancy review and AI cost diff; humans merge.

g.title: 3. CI runs the spec gate, tenant-isolation tests, AI tenancy review and AI cost diff; humans merge.

g.data-tip: Only merged changes deploy, via CDK to CloudFormation, with an OIDC role.

g.title: 4. Only merged changes deploy, via CDK to CloudFormation, with an OIDC role.

g.data-tip: Per-tenant metrics, agent traces and online evaluations land in CloudWatch Omni.

g.title: 6. Per-tenant metrics, agent traces and online evaluations land in CloudWatch Omni.
